description: TRON super representatives and candidates: who is producing blocks, how many they produced, how many they missed, votes and websites - read from our own node. When to use: governance or staking questions about TRON, or checking the health of block production. Do not use: for account balances (tron_get_account). Returns: registered_witnesses, active_block_producers, top_by_blocks_produced[] with address, url, blocks_produced, blocks_missed, votes, in_active_set.

limit.description: How many top producers to return (default 30)
